scientific_integrity: The phase classification follows analytically from the exact published threshold formula. Numerical replay is corroborative only. A related doctoral thesis was located but its full text was not accessible for complete comparison.
scientific_limitations: This result classifies the sufficient condition \(\gamma>\gamma_c\) from the cited construction. It does not establish necessity of that condition or identify a sharp physical stability boundary.
title: Exact mass–particle phase diagram of the Ferretti–Teta stability certificate
